samples.instruction: Task: MRI modality translation (T1-weighted to T2 fat-suppressed). Input: axial T1-weighted (T1WI) salivary-gland MRI slice. Target: T2 fat-suppressed (T2FS) slice at the same anatomical level. Instruction: Convert T1 contrast to T2FS appearance—emphasize fluid and soft-tissue signal expected on fat-suppressed T2, preserve lesion location, gland margins, and spatial anatomy without adding or removing pathology.
